description: 整合 Footwork AR002、AR003、AR004、AR005 的暫定能力分數。
limitations: Component weights are provisional and have not been calibrated by badminton coaches.
The competency score summarizes the current test video and does not represent the user's complete badminton level.
Direction coverage describes system-observed test completion and may be affected by camera angle or classification error.
Footwork technique items such as split step, lead foot, extra steps, and coach similarity are not included.
